name: Gianni Infantino
role: FIFA president since 2016, seeking a fourth term
backing: Endorsed by CAF, the AFC and CONMEBOL, and by dozens of individual federations. Says he has the support of the vast majority of associations.
status: Candidature confirmed Nov 19, pending admission by the electoral committee
note: Faces a dispute over term limits: critics point to Article 33 of the FIFA statutes, and the FIFA Council ruled in December 2022 that his first three years do not count.

name: Philippe Diallo
role: President of the French Football Federation since January 2023
backing: Backed by UEFA, whose 55 associations are reported to have pledged unanimous support.
status: Candidature confirmed Nov 19, pending admission by the electoral committee
note: Announced with the support of the UEFA associations on the FIFA Council and the UEFA executive committee.

name: Kozo Tashima
role: Honorary president of the Japan Football Association, FIFA Council member since 2015
backing: No confederation endorsement reported. Japan has never fielded a FIFA presidential candidate.
status: Candidature confirmed Nov 19, pending admission by the electoral committee
note: Has put his own chances at 20 to 30 percent, according to Al Jazeera.

name: Ramon Vega
status: Announced his intention to run, but was not among the candidates FIFA named
note: Declared on Oct 7, 2026. FIFA's Nov 19 release lists only Diallo, Infantino and Tashima.
